Silverline.SL_BankDef.label: Silverline Mutual
Silverline.SL_BankDef.description: The calm, neutral default. Quietly holds your silver, charges fair fees and has never once been in the news. The clerks are suspiciously well rested.
Silverline.SL_BankDef.slogan: Quietly holding things since the Third Collapse.

perks.li: Neutral and fair: no tricks, no surprises.

Silverline.SL_BankDef.label: First Rim Bank of Too Big To Fail
Silverline.SL_BankDef.description: Satire in a marble lobby. Higher yields, higher fees, and once per game year it will rescue a customer who has been truly, spectacularly rich and is now not. The rescue is a loan, not a gift. Nobody reads that part.
Silverline.SL_BankDef.slogan: So big we had to name it twice.

perks.li: Best account yield of the mainstream banks (+10 % in the exponent).
Bailout: once per game year, a customer who was a Too Big To Fail ten minutes ago and is now in the red gets an interest-free 60 day loan (up to 10 % of the peak).

Silverline.SL_BankDef.label: Imperial Treasury
Silverline.SL_BankDef.description: The Throne's own counting house. Low fees, a faint smell of floor polish and credit only for those who bear a title. Withdrawals are called "disbursements" and come with a small bow.
Silverline.SL_BankDef.slogan: Every coin bears the Throne's profile. Please do not bite it.

perks.li: Loans only if somebody in the colony holds a royal title; very cheap interest.
Slightly lower account yield (-10 % in the exponent).

Silverline.SL_BankDef.label: Orbital Exchange
Silverline.SL_BankDef.description: A trading-guild bank on a very expensive rotating ring. Best market access in the rim, highest fees in the rim, and every receipt arrives with a small chart that goes up and to the right.
Silverline.SL_BankDef.slogan: Liquidity at the speed of light. Fees too.

perks.li: Best market access once investments are researched.
Highest fees: 0.5 % to deposit, 2 % to withdraw (minimum 10), account fee 10 silver per quadrum.

Silverline.SL_BankDef.label: The Black Ledger
Silverline.SL_BankDef.description: No questions, no forms, no names. Lends to anyone, whatever their score, at a price. Once in a while a ledger "goes missing" and a share of the deposits with it.
Silverline.SL_BankDef.slogan: We don't ask. You don't tell. The interest still compounds.

perks.li: Loans ignore your credit score (and your feelings).
Every quadrum there is a 1 % risk that a quarter of the balance is "seized".
Only open to colonies that found the underworld.

Silverline.SL_BankDef.label: First Church of Compound Interest
Silverline.SL_BankDef.description: A congregation that worships the miracle of exponential growth. Modest fees, a hymn for every balance sheet and a donation box that is, strictly speaking, optional.
Silverline.SL_BankDef.slogan: In compound we trust. Tithe early, tithe often.

perks.li: Low fees and gentle loans, paid for by a small account fee.
Home of the faith funds (once investments and indulgences are researched).
